notes.title: Full Version of DEEEER Simulator: Your Average Everyday Deer Game Now Available!
notes.notes:
Dear Users,

It's been too long a wait, but we are so happy to finally be able to bring you the full version of DEEEER Simulator!
[previewyoutube=7KplmjTjLKY;full][/previewyoutube]

The full version comes with a host of exciting new features and updates.
Along the way, many of you were kind enough to offer support and words of encouragement as we worked on development, and for that, words cannot express how thankful we are.
Well, without further ado, jump into the game to find out the fate that awaits our favorite average, everyday deer!
[list]
[*]Final boss
[*]Opening and ending sequence
[*]Newly added BGM composed by original artists
[*]Steam Achievements
[*]Additional Language Support
[/list]
Apart from the above, we have also incorporated many user requests and fixed a long list of minor bugs.

[h3]The Final Evolution of DEEEER DLC[/h3]
Want MOAR DEEEER?! (No, really - we'd actually like to know.)）
Unleash the full power of our deer friend with this DLC pack.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1801910/

[h3]16-Track Original Soundtrack also Available![/h3]
Enjoy these amazing and wacky tracks composed specifically for DEEEER Simulator!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1801900/

[h3]Fully Jacked DEEEER Edition[/h3]
Get the game along with the DLC pack and original soundtrack together for 10% off the total price! With so much DEEEER goodness in this bundle, you definitely won't regret it!
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23731/

Now, go on and live your deer life to the fullest!

notes.title: DEEEER Simulator Full Release on 11/25!
notes.notes:
Dear Users,

It's been a long time since DEEEER Simulator's Early Access release in January 2020 and after a long period of development, we are finally ready to release DEEEER Simulator's full version to all of you! 

The full version features an expanded storyline, taking you face to face with the final boss at the end.

Full Release Announcement Trailer:
[previewyoutube=gzvsASITILg;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Seven Additional Languages![/b]

To bring this game to an even wider audience, the full version will feature full support for seven new languages!

Players all over the world will be able to enjoy DEEEER Simulator in English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Italian, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, and Russian.

The full version of DEEEER Simulator is coming to Steam on 11/25!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1018800/_DEEEER_Simulator/

notes.title: Just a normal deer, rampaging across the continent of Orchestra! Early Access Release!
notes.notes:
Dear Fans,
Just your average everyday deer game, DEEEER Simulator, has finally been released into early access!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/fbe0d74d2d964232f185afeb8dbdd13360b0c137.gif[/img]

Please rampage your way across the first area, the continent of Orchestra, to whet your appetite.
We plan on listening to everybody’s feedback and making the deer more and more ordinary. You can leave your feedback on the feedback discussion thread.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/1a858fff361c560d008e2ddd23c06e7fd2540d04.gif[/img]

[h1]Release Celebration Campaign!!![/h1]

To celebrate the release of this average everyday game about deer we will be giving out packs of custom made Deer Senbei (for human consumption). To enter please follow us on twitter (@playismJP) and post a video of you playing with the METAL DEER in game with the hashtags #DEEEERSimulator and #DEEEERSenbei. The first 50 people will get their hands on these awesome DEEEER Simulator crackers!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/029269ecf01e0dfe94a4debeb2a85804195d6270.jpg[/img]

*Please do not feed to deer.
*As these are a food product, please be aware that your country’s import rules on foodstuffs will apply.
*Winners will be informed by DM from our twitter account.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/9e3b6c7b9b11410e35c072923e6a3014ab6c9c11.png[/img]
